findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/Binomial.lean:380` `def choose ... [BinomialRing R]`; `:277` `noncomputable instance {R} [AddCommMonoid R] [Module ℚ≥0 R] [Pow R ℕ] : BinomialRing R`; grep `Module ℚ≥0` over `code/TauCeti` matches only KostantForm.lean:66-68; `Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Rat.lean` has no `Module ℚ≥0` instance for ℚ-algebras.
findings.fix: Make it `scoped instance` in `TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra` (or a genuine instance for `[Semiring A] [Algebra ℚ A]` in a shared file) so consumers get it by `open`, and fix the docstring to say it is what supplies `BinomialRing` for `Ring.choose`.
findings.issue: `kostantFormModuleNNRat` is a `local instance`, so it does not survive import; it is the only source of `Module ℚ≥0 (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra ℚ L)` and hence of the `BinomialRing` instance that `Ring.choose` needs. Downstream (the Chevalley construction that is supposed to consume this) cannot elaborate any goal mentioning `Ring.choose (ι ℚ (h i)) n`, so `choose_mem_kostantForm`, `kostantForm_le_iff`, `image_kostantCartanGenerators` and `choose_mem_kostantCartanGenerators` are unusable without each consumer re-declaring the instance — and a re-declared copy is a syntactically different instance term, so `simp`/`rw` will not match. The docstring is also wrong: divided powers need `[Algebra ℚ A]` (`Associative.lean:55,61`), not `Module ℚ≥0`; the instance exists for `Ring.choose`.

findings.evidence: `Functoriality.lean:83` `map_ι` vs `:91` `@[simp] map_ι'` with the comment "simp-normal form is `map_ι'`"; `Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/UniversalEnveloping.lean:132,136` `lift_ι_apply`/`lift_ι_apply'`; `KostantForm.lean:130` needs `simpa` to bridge the two forms.
findings.fix: Follow the convention this file's own dependency uses (`map_ι`/`map_ι'`, mirroring Mathlib's `lift_ι_apply`/`lift_ι_apply'`): state `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm` and `choose_mem_kostantForm` with `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι`, and add primed `mkAlgHom`-form companions carrying the `@[simp]` tags.
findings.issue: `dividedPower_mem_kostantForm` (114) and `choose_mem_kostantForm` (122) are stated only in the unfolded `mkAlgHom ℚ L (TensorAlgebra.ι ℚ _)` form. The natural general-`n` statement in terms of `UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.ι` — the form used by `kostantForm_le_iff` (143) and by `rootVector_mem_kostantForm` (129) — does not exist, so a consumer holding an `ι`-shaped goal must unfold `ι` by hand; conversely `rootVector_mem_kostantForm`/`cartanVector_mem_kostantForm` are stated in the `ι` form that `simp` immediately normalizes away, so they cannot fire.

findings.evidence: `kostantForm` (95) is a plain `def` with no `@[expose]` and no defining-equation lemma; the generator defs are used only by `kostantForm` (97) and by `image_kostant*` (161,174,188), which in turn serve only `map_kostantForm` (197).
findings.fix: Add `theorem kostantForm_def (e h) : kostantForm e h = Subring.closure (kostantGenerators e h) := (rfl)` (or a `kostantForm_induction` wrapper) and make `dividedPower_mem_kostantRootGenerators`/`choose_mem_kostantCartanGenerators` `private`; alternatively make the whole generator layer `private` and keep only `kostantForm_le_iff` plus an induction principle.
findings.issue: `kostantRootGenerators`, `kostantCartanGenerators`, `kostantGenerators` and the two trivial range-membership lemmas (100, 107) are public, but `kostantForm`'s body is not exposed and no lemma states `kostantForm e h = Subring.closure (kostantGenerators e h)`. Downstream the generator sets are therefore dead surface, and there is no elimination principle: `Subring.closure_induction` cannot be applied to `kostantForm`, which the announced follow-up PBW/integrality results will need.

findings.evidence: `Functoriality.lean:113` `@[simp] map_id`, `:122` `@[simp] map_comp` exist for the underlying map; `KostantForm.lean` exports only `coe_kostantFormMap_apply` (213) and `coe_kostantFormEquiv_apply` (246).
findings.fix: Add `kostantFormMap_id`, `kostantFormMap_comp`, `kostantFormEquiv_toRingHom : (kostantFormEquiv g e h).toRingHom = kostantFormMap g.toLieHom e h`, and a `@[simp] coe_kostantFormEquiv_symm_apply`; each follows from `coe_kostantFormMap_apply` with `RingHom.ext`/`Subtype.ext`.
findings.issue: `kostantFormMap` and `kostantFormEquiv` lack the interaction lemmas with the operations already in scope: no `kostantFormMap_id`/`kostantFormMap_comp` counterparts to the imported `map_id`/`map_comp`, and nothing links `kostantFormEquiv` to `kostantFormMap` or characterizes its inverse. A consumer transporting along a composite of pinned-root-datum isomorphisms has no lemma to rewrite with.

summary: The Cartan half of the public API is stated in terms of `Ring.choose`, whose `BinomialRing` instance comes solely from a file-local `Module ℚ≥0` instance, so no consumer can state or reuse it. The general-`n` membership lemmas are exported only in the unfolded `mkAlgHom` form, and the exported generator sets have no lemma connecting them to `kostantForm`.
